title: Monotonicity of uniform expectation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer and let $f,g\colon\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $f(x)\le g(x)$ for every $x\in\{0,1\}^n$. Then their uniform expectations satisfy $\E[f]\le\E[g]$.
replaced:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$ and $f,g:\{0,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$ satisfy $f(x)\le g(x)$ for every $x$.
Then $\mathbb E[f]\le\mathbb E[g]$, where $\mathbb E[h]=2^{-n}\sum_{x\in\{0,1\}^n}h(x)$ is uniform expectation.
